title: Construct an odd E8 direct-sum decoder with vanishing pairing tariff (no new κ)
body:
This construction gives 1,404,928 rank-one binary ports in dimension 25, a dyadic fitting matrix of rank 20,480, and an explicit decoder with source/reader pairing tariff 311,296. The tariff per port is 76/343, compared with 4/7 for the single P112 factor. It changes the port geometry. It does not replace a paid job in the selected supplier.

**No complete kappa improvement is established.** Native production, the physical COPY service, the chronological readout order and complete restoration remain open. The exact budget gate leaves less than 1/9 per port per local invocation for all omitted work at the planning exponent 0.0031. A favorable incomplete moment is not a supplier or outer exponent. A second exact gate charges COPY by full source dimensions 15 and 22, for mass 333,824. It still leaves between 1/4 and 3/10 per port at 0.0031. This gives an alternative cost target; acquisition, compatible reads and restoration remain unproved.

Read the [proof](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/88f7559482941112246493e5750174e5dc0d1eb2/research/odd-e8-direct-sum/PROOF.md), [exact certificate](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/88f7559482941112246493e5750174e5dc0d1eb2/research/odd-e8-direct-sum/RESULT.json), and [verifier](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/88f7559482941112246493e5750174e5dc0d1eb2/research/odd-e8-direct-sum/verify.py). For every odd k, the written construction gives 112^k ports in dimension 8k+1. Its decoder uses products of at least (k+1)/2 rank-eight factors, and its pairing tariff per port tends to zero. This does not bound native production cost or prove a minimum decoder tariff.

For k=3, the fitting matrix is `(C1*C2 + C1*C3 + C2*C3 - C1*C2*C3)/2`. The decoder has 21,504 terms of pairing rank 14 and 512 of pairing rank 20. Their source spans have dimensions 15 and 22; these dimensions are not interchangeable with the pairing ranks. The 2,744 product cubes also support an explicit scalar involution between orthogonal 256-port classes. This supplies the local K component of `K+H+F=I`; no native H word is supplied.

The scientific base is canonical main `1a3ced60b2f7a46bc70280a04f2eeb8ca027c700`. A pre-submission refresh reached `32890bc5de034ab8fc93ac88ead7279a6a416d04`; the relevant instructions, task catalogue, selected record and consumed normalizer bytes did not change. [Source pins](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/88f7559482941112246493e5750174e5dc0d1eb2/research/odd-e8-direct-sum/SOURCES.json) retain the original base. The [scoped Discussion claim](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/1587#discussioncomment-19164011) records the bounded overlap check. The fused-T/Global120 caller and other current native callers are outside this scope.

Verification uses Python 3.12 and the standard library:

```sh
python3.12 -I -W error -B research/odd-e8-direct-sum/verify.py
python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/odd-e8-direct-sum
python3.12 -B scripts/check_research_commit.py --package research/odd-e8-direct-sum
```

Expected markers:

```text
PASS_ODD_E8_DIRECT_SUM_COMPONENT ports=1404928 dimension=25 rank=20480 pairing_mass=311296
PASS_REGISTERED_RESEARCH_PACKAGE research/odd-e8-direct-sum outcome=partial
PASS_RESEARCH_COMMIT_BYTES
```

Normal and optimized registered checks pass. A read-only Git-free export from the committed bytes passes both direct checks. Exact checks cover all 12,544 base entries, eight feature support contracts, 7,168 feature-pair supports, 512 feature triples, all 2,744 product-cube parity spans, and coefficients and spectra for odd k through 15. Integer power inequalities certify the rational budget interval. Four controls reject altered root data, altered binary labels, a reversed cubic sign and an omitted degree-two layer.

The full mask and all-k claims use written tensor arguments, with finite corroboration. The enormous matrix is not materialized. Independent human review, formal proof-kernel verification, selected native replay, compiler, precision and outer admission checks are not claimed. Full source-history checking was not run in this shallow checkout. Hosted CI remains separate from the local checks.

Credit: @Dugongue's [PR #4929](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/4929) supplies the stable rank-eight code and factorization. Dillon's retained [physical source note](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/blob/1a3ced60b2f7a46bc70280a04f2eeb8ca027c700/research/coded-native-caller/PHYSICAL.md) and [task record](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/blob/1a3ced60b2f7a46bc70280a04f2eeb8ca027c700/research/coded-native-caller/TASK.json) supply the literal normalizers and source attribution. Retain Cao Yifan, Cinna Davis, zxv, Jacob Alan Sussman and the predecessors credited there. Multilinear majority and tensor eigenspace calculations are standard algebra; no new general identity is claimed.

Prepared by Ali Romman with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance. Apache-2.0. The change adds one opt-in research package and changes no shared code, predecessor evidence or selected frontier.
